y-m-60-08.goal: Qhathanisa uhlelo olukhula ngenani elimisiwe unyaka ngamunye nolukhula ngesilinganiso esimisiwe, funda ukuthi esingcono sincike esikhathini, futhi unikeze izeluleko kubantu abasezimeni ezahlukene usho imicabango yakho.

y-m-60-03.title: Zingaki izinombolo zesilinganiso esingazethemba?
y-m-60-03.topic: Izilinganiso zama-logarithm avamile nenani lezinombolo: singazethemba kangakanani isilinganiso?
y-m-60-03.goal: Funda ukuthi iphutha elincane esilinganisweni lingashintsha isiphetho njengoba n ikhula, thola amacala lapho isiphetho sihluka khona, bese usho imibandela lapho isilinganiso singathenjwa khona.
y-m-60-03.material: Sifuna ukuthola ukuthi 2ⁿ inezinombolo ezingakanani. Inani lezinombolo zenombolo ephelele eyiphozithivu N ngu-(ingxenye ephelele ye-log N) + 1, ngakho inani lezinombolo ze-2ⁿ ngu-(ingxenye ephelele ka-n × log 2) + 1. Inani langempela le-log 2 lingu-0.30102999566…, kodwa uSoyoung usebenzise isilinganiso 0.301 futhi wathola inani lezinombolo ngokwengeza u-1 engxenyeni ephelele ka-n × 0.301. (Ingxenye ephelele yinombolo ephelele ngaphambi kwephoyinti ledesimali. Isibonelo: ingxenye ephelele ka-9.03 ngu-9.)
y-m-60-03.thinking.1: Thola wena amacala lapho isiphetho sihluka
y-m-60-03.prereq.0: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwama-logarithm avamile nenani lezinombolo (inani lezinombolo zenombolo ephelele eyiphozithivu N lingxenye ephelele ye-log N kwengeziwe u-1)
y-m-60-03.prereq.1: Iqiniso lokuthi inani le-log 2 licishe libe ngu-0.301, nokusebenzisa i-calculator
y-m-60-03.prereq.2: Leli yizinga lobunzima lalo msebenzi (H3), hhayi ukwabelwa konyaka wesikole, futhi licabanga ukuthi usuqedile iyunithi yama-logarithm avamile.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.prompt: Ku-n=30, uSoyoung uthe 30 × 0.301 = 9.03, ngakho 2³⁰ yinombolo yezinombolo ezingu-10. Singasethemba lesi siphetho? Phindaphinda u-30 nenani langempela 0.30102999566…, uqhathanise, bese ukhetha.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala inani lezikhathi ezingu-30 zesilinganiso nenani lezikhathi ezingu-30 zenani langempela eceleni komunye nomunye, ezindaweni ezine zamadesimali.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa umehluko phakathi kwamanani amabili nebanga kusuka enanini elibaliwe kuya enombolweni ephelele eseduze.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.o.a: Njengoba kusetshenziswe isilinganiso kunephutha, ngakho asikwazi ukwazi inani lezinombolo size sibale ngenani eliqondile
y-m-60-03.s.s1.r.a: Inani langempela selivele linikeziwe, ngakho ukuqhathanisa imiphumela emibili kutshela usayizi wephutha. Cabanga ukuthi iphutha likhulu ngokwanele ukushintsha isiphetho yini.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.o.b: 9.03 ikude nenombolo ephelele 9 kunephutha (ngaphansi kuka-0.001), ngakho isiphetho sezinombolo ezingu-10 siyabamba
y-m-60-03.s.s1.o.c: Isilinganiso sincane kunenani langempela, ngakho inani langempela lezinombolo lihlala liyinombolo eyodwa ngaphezulu kwenombolo etholwe ngesilinganiso
y-m-60-03.s.s1.r.c: Inani elincane kancane alishintshi ngokuqinisekile ingxenye ephelele. Cabanga ukuthi kufanele kwenzeke ini ukuze ingxenye ephelele ishintshe.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.o.d: 0.301 nenani langempela kuyavumelana kuze kube yindawo yesithathu yedesimali, ngakho inani lezinombolo liyafana kunoma yiluphi u-n
y-m-60-03.s.s1.r.d: Iphutha likhula izikhathi ezingu-n uma liphindaphindwa ngo-n. Qhathanisa icala n=30 nelicala lapho n ikhulu kakhulu.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.explain: 30 × 0.30102999566… = 9.0309… no-30 × 0.301 = 9.03, ngakho umehluko ungaphansi kuka-0.001. Wonke amanani amabili aphakathi kuka-9 no-10, ngakho ingxenye ephelele ingu-9 kuwo womabili amacala, futhi 2³⁰ yinombolo yezinombolo ezingu-10 (2³⁰ = 1073741824). Ukuthi isilinganiso singathenjwa yini kuncike kusayizi wephutha nokuthi inani elibaliwe likude kangakanani nenombolo ephelele.
y-m-60-03.s.s2.prompt: Thola futhi ufake izinombolo zemvelo ezimbili ezahlukile n lapho inani lezinombolo ze-2ⁿ elitholwe ngendlela kaSoyoung (usebenzisa 0.301) nangenani langempela (usebenzisa 0.30102999566…) lihluka. (Inani lezinombolo = ingxenye ephelele ka-n × log 2 + 1)
y-m-60-03.s.s2.hint.0: Bala ngama-n amaningana bese ufuna u-n lapho ingxenye yedesimali ka-n × 0.301 isondele kakhulu ku-1.
y-m-60-03.s.s2.hint.1: Bala amanani ambalwa ubone ukuthi umehluko phakathi kuka-n×0.301 no-n×(inani langempela) ushintsha kanjani njengoba n ikhula.
y-m-60-03.s.s2.fail.c1: n kufanele ibe yinombolo yemvelo engu-1 noma ngaphezulu.
y-m-60-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Amanani ezinombolo atholwe ngezindlela ezimbili ayahluka.
y-m-60-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Amanani ezinombolo atholwe ngezindlela ezimbili ayafana. Qhathanisa izingxenye eziphelele zika-n×0.301 no-n×0.30102999566.
y-m-60-03.s.s2.explain: Nge-n=196, 196 × 0.301 = 58.996 inengxenye ephelele engu-58, ngakho isho izinombolo ezingu-59, kodwa ngenani langempela, 196 × 0.30102999566… = 59.0018…, ngakho ingxenye ephelele ingu-59 futhi 2¹⁹⁶ yinombolo yezinombolo ezingu-60. Okufanayo kwenzeka nge-n=299 (izinombolo ezingu-91) no-n=392 (izinombolo ezingu-119). Uma inani elibaliwe lingaphansi nje kwenombolo ephelele, iphutha elincane lingenza ukuthi lidlule noma lingadluli enombolweni ephelele, futhi isiphetho siyashintsha.
y-m-60-03.s.s3.prompt: Ku-n=30 besingakwazi ukwethemba isilinganiso, kodwa hhayi ku-n owusanda kuwuthola. Emshweni owodwa noma emibili, bhala ukuthi yini ehlukanisa amacala lapho inani lezinombolo elitholwe ngesilinganiso 0.301 lingathenjwa nalawo lapho lingenakwethenjwa.
y-m-60-03.s.s3.hint.0: Ku-n=30 nange-n=196, bhala ukuthi n×0.301 ikude kangakanani nenombolo ephelele eseduze.
y-m-60-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Usho ukuthi kuyingozi uma inani elibaliwe liphansi nje (noma liphezulu) kunenombolo ephelele?
y-m-60-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Uhlole lokho okushilo nge-n owayithola (isibonelo, 196) noma ngokubala ku-n=30?
y-m-60-03.s.s3.model.0: Iphutha lesilinganiso liphindaphindwa ngo-n, ngakho okukhulu u-n, iphutha liba likhulu. Ngakho uma u-n×0.301 usondele kakhulu enombolweni ephelele, iphutha lingenza kudlule noma kungadluli inombolo ephelele futhi lishintshe inani lamadijithi, futhi uma ikude nenombolo ephelele, ungathemba.
y-m-60-03.s.s3.model.1: Uma inani elibaliwe u-9.03 likude nenombolo ephelele, njengakwa-30, ingxenye yenombolo ephelele ayishintshi noma ngephutha (cishe 0.001). Uma inani elibaliwe lingu-58.996, eduze kakhulu nenombolo ephelele u-59, njengakwa-196, umehluko omncane ushintsha inani lamadijithi.
y-m-60-03.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ayisho ukuthi iphutha likhula no-n, kodwa ithola iphuzu eliyinhloko ngokuqhathanisa ibanga elisuka enombolweni ephelele nephutha.

y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Le datha ishintsha kanjani isinqumo sakho?
y-m-60-05.title: Isikhathi esiphindayo sezinga lolwandle: idatha ingasitshela kangakanani?
y-m-60-05.topic: Isikhathi somsebenzi we-sine: ukuthi isikhathi singanqunywa kuze kube kuphi kusuka kumalinganiselo athathwe ngezikhathi ezijwayelekile
y-m-60-05.goal: Funda ukuthi idatha elinganiswe ngezikhawu ezincane ayikwazi ukunquma isikhathi, lungisa isahlulelo sakho njengoba kufika idatha eyengeziwe, futhi uqhathanise amamodeli abantu abangaba nguwo namalinganiselo ngqo.
y-m-60-05.material: Sifuna ukulinganisa izinga lolwandle (m) ethekwini futhi silivezele ngefomula yefomu u-h(t) = 3 + 2·sin(2πt/T). U-t isikhathi (ngamahora) kusukela ngo-0 o'clock, futhi u-T yisikhathi (ngamahora). Amalinganiselo azungezisiwe emayunithini angu-0.1 m futhi angashintsha cishe ngo-±0.2 m ngenxa yamagagasi. Inhloso ukunquma u-T. (Indlela yokufunda: u-2πt/T ngu-'2π t over T'.)
y-m-60-05.thinking.1: Lungisa isahlulelo nokuqiniseka ngokuya ngedatha entsha
y-m-60-05.thinking.2: Qhathanisa amamodeli abantu abangaba nguwo namalinganiselo
y-m-60-05.prereq.0: Isikhathi u-2π/b nobukhulu bomsebenzi u-y = a·sin(bx) + c
y-m-60-05.prereq.1: Amanani emisebenzi ye-trigonometric ngama-radian (setha ikhalkhuletha kumodi ye-radian ukubala)
y-m-60-05.prereq.2: Lesi sinqumo sizinga lobunzima salo msebenzi (H3), hhayi ukwabiwa konyaka wesikole, futhi sicabanga ukuthi usufunde amagrafu emisebenzi ye-trigonometric.
y-m-60-05.s.s1.prompt: Idatha iyembulwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi. Isikhathi ngasinye, khetha isahlulelo esinengqondo kakhulu.
y-m-60-05.s.s1.hint.0: Esigabeni ngasinye, qhathanisa ukuthi yiliphi kwabantu abangaba nguwo owawucabange ngaphambilini idatha entsha esiyikhiphile.
y-m-60-05.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha isikhathi esisodwa esingaba yisona, bala ubude ezikhathini ezembuliwe wena, futhi uvumelanise namalinganiselo.
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Lawa ngamanani alinganiswe ngezikhawu zamahora angu-3. t=0: 3.0 m, t=3: 5.0 m, t=6: 3.2 m, t=9: 1.0 m. Uma u-T=12, ifomula inika u-3.0, 5.0, 3.0, 1.0 m ngokulandelana.
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ngedatha yamanje, yisiphi isahlulelo esinengqondo kakhulu mayelana nesikhathi?

y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Isikhathi singamahora angu-12. Wonke amanani amane afanela kahle imodeli u-T=12

y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Amahora angu-12 kungenzeka, kodwa izikhathi ezimfushane nazo ziyenzeka, ngakho kusenesikhathi sokuqiniseka
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Isikhathi singamahora angu-3. Njengoba amanani alinganiswe njalo emahoreni angu-3, lowo mkhawulo uyisikhathi
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Amanani ahlukile: u-3.0 ku-t=0 no-5.0 ku-t=3. Uma isikhathi besingu-3, inani elifanayo bekumele liphindeke.
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Kunamaphoyinti edatha amane kuphela, ngakho asikwazi ukusho lutho ngesikhathi
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ukunciphisa abantu abangaba nguwo kuyenzeka. Cabanga ukuthi yibaphi abantu abangaba nguwo abaphikisana nedatha.

y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Imodeli yokuqala u-T=12 cishe ilungile kodwa ayinembile. Amalinganiselo amabili ngemuva kwamahora angu-12 nangemuva kwamahora angu-24 achazwa uma u-T ehluka kancane ku-12. Yiliphi inani elilungile lizoqhathaniswa ngokubala abantu abangaba nguwo esinyathelweni esilandelayo.
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Gcina u-T=12. Cabanga ukuthi amalinganiselo avele ashintsha ngenxa yamagagasi

y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: U-T=12 akachazi amalinganiselo amabili. Bala abanye abantu abangaba nguwo ba-T futhi ubaqhathanise
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Njengoba inani ku-t=24 lingu-2.2, imodeli enomumo we-sine uqobo iphosile

y-m-60-05.s.s1.reflect: Ukuthatha amahora angu-12 njengo-'omunye ongaba nguye onokwenzeka' kunokuba 'uqinisekisa' kudatha yokuqala kusize kanjani kudatha yokugcina? Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uma ubuqinisekisile amahora angu-12, yiluphi idatha ebingazamazamisa lowo mbono?
y-m-60-05.s.s2.prompt: Yimuphi kwabantu abangaba nguwo ba-T ochaza kokubili amalinganiselo ngemuva kwamahora angu-12 nangemuva kwamahora angu-24 (t=12: 2.6 m, t=24: 2.2 m) ngaphakathi kuka-±0.2 m? Bala u-h(12) no-h(24) kumuntu ngamunye angaba nguye futhi uqhathanise.

U-T=12 unika u-3.0 no-3.0, u-T=13 unika u-2.07 no-1.35, futhi u-T=11.5 unika u-3.54 no-4.04, ngakho abakwazi ukuchaza amalinganiselo womabili ngasikhathi sinye. y-m-60-04.title: Uma u-sin θ engu-3/5, u-cos θ unqunywe ngokukhethekile?
y-m-60-04.topic: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwemisebenzi ye-trigonometric: izimo lapho u-cos θ no-tan θ banqunywa uma u-sin θ enikeziwe
y-m-60-04.goal: Bonisa, ngokuthola wonke amanani angenzeka, ukuthi inani le-sine lodwa alinquli amanani e-cosine ne-tangent ngokukhethekile, futhi ukhethe ulwazi olwengeziwe olulungisa amanani.
y-m-60-04.material: I-engeli u-θ iyi-engeli ejwayelekile (akunandaba noma kungama-radian noma amadigri) futhi u-sin θ = 3/5. UHarin wathi, "Njengoba u-sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, u-cos θ = 4/5 no-tan θ = 3/4." (Indlela yokufunda: u-sin θ ngu-'sine theta', u-sin²θ ngu-'sine theta squared', futhi u-3/5 ngu-'three fifths'.)
y-m-60-04.prereq.0: Incazelo yemisebenzi ye-trigonometric yama-engeli ajwayelekile nezimpawu zawo ku-quadrant ngayinye
y-m-60-04.prereq.2: Lesi sinqumo sizinga lobunzima salo msebenzi (H3), hhayi ukwabiwa konyaka wesikole, futhi sicabanga ukuthi uqedile inyunithi yemisebenzi ye-trigonometric.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.prompt: Siyiphi isahlulelo esifaneleke kakhulu mayelana nesiphetho sikaHarin?
y-m-60-04.s.s1.hint.0: Thola inani luka-cos²θ, bese ubala ukuthi mingaki izinombolo ezinenani elilinganayo uma kwenziwa isikwele.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi yiziphi ama-quadrant aqukethe ama-engeli anou-sin θ ophozithivu.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.o.a: Kulungile. Kusuka ku-sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, u-cos θ = 4/5 no-tan θ = 3/4 banqunyiwe
y-m-60-04.s.s1.r.a: Hlola ukuthi likhona yini inombolo eyodwa kuphela isikwele sayo singu-16/25.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.o.b: U-cos θ uphuma njengamanani amabili, u-4/5 no--4/5, kodwa isivumelwano ukuthatha impande yesikwele ephozithivu, ngakho unqunywa ngu-4/5
y-m-60-04.s.s1.r.b: Isivumelwano sokuthatha impande ephozithivu simayelana nophawu lwempande yesikwele. Hlola ukuthi i-engeli lapho u-cos θ enegethivu inganeliswa u-sin θ = 3/5 yini.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.o.c: U-cos θ ungaba ngu-4/5 noma u--4/5, ngakho akanqunywa njengenani elilodwa ngolwazi olunikeziwe kuphela
y-m-60-04.s.s1.o.d: Uma u-sin θ = 3/5, khona-ke u-θ kumele abe yi-engeli ku-quadrant yokuqala, ngakho inani likaHarin lilungile
y-m-60-04.s.s1.r.d: Hlola ukuthi ama-engeli anou-sin θ ophozithivu akhona kuphela ku-quadrant yokuqala yini.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.explain: Njengoba u-sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, u-cos²θ = 1 − 9/25 = 16/25, ngakho u-cos θ = 4/5 noma u--4/5. Uma u-sin θ>0, u-θ ukuku-quadrant yokuqala noma yesibili, ngakho kokubili amacala ayenzeka.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.prompt: Thola futhi ufake amapheya amabili ahlukile angenzeka amanani u-(cos θ, tan θ) e-engeli u-θ onou-sin θ = 3/5. (Bhala izingxenyana njengama-decimal. Isibonelo: 3/5 = 0.6)
y-m-60-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qala uthole u-cos²θ, bese uthola wonke amanani luka-cos θ awunikezayo.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kuma-cos θ ngamunye, bala u-sin θ ÷ cos θ ukuthola u-tan θ.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Akusiso u-sin²θ + cos²θ = 1. U-sin²θ ungu-0.36. Hlola ukuthi isikwele luka-cos θ kufanele sibe yini.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Unelisa u-tan θ = sin θ ÷ cos θ.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.fail.c2: U-tan θ × cos θ akalingani no-sin θ = 0.6. Thola u-tan θ futhi.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.explain: Uma u-cos θ = 0.8, bese u-tan θ = 0.6 ÷ 0.8 = 0.75, futhi uma u-cos θ = −0.8, bese u-tan θ = −0.75. Lezi ezimbili ziyiwo wonke amathuba.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.prompt: Sifuna ukucela ulwazi olwengeziwe ukukhetha phakathi kwamathuba amabili. Khetha lonke ulwazi olungezansi olungeza ku-sin θ = 3/5, olwalunquma u-(cos θ, tan θ) ngokukhethekile noma lunikezwa oluyedwa kuphela.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.hint.0: Faka abantu abangaba nguwo ababili (0.8, 0.75) no-(−0.8, −0.75) esimweni senketho ngayinye.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.hint.1: Hlukanisa izinketho ezanelisa bobabili abantu abangaba nguwo nalezo eziyanelisa oyedwa kuphela.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.r.b: Phakathi kuka-0 no-π kunama-engeli kokubili ku-quadrant yokuqala neyesibili. Bheka ukuthi bobabili abantu abangaba nguwo basala yini.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.o.c: Iqiniso lokuthi u-cos θ + sin θ < 1
y-m-60-04.s.s3.o.d: Iqiniso lokuthi u-θ uyi-engeli ku-quadrant yokuqala noma yesibili
y-m-60-04.s.s3.r.d: Uma u-sin θ>0, lokhu sekuvele kuyaziwa. Hlola ukuthi kuyilwazi olusha yini.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.r.e: Kubo bobabili abantu abangaba nguwo, u-cos θ akasiwo u-0. Hlola ukuthi ungabahlukanisa yini.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.o.f: Iqiniso lokuthi u-sin θ × cos θ > 0
y-m-60-04.s.s3.explain: Abantu abangaba nguwo ngu-(0.8, 0.75) no-(−0.8, −0.75). a: u-tan θ<0 uneliswa owesibili kuphela. c: u-cos θ + sin θ ungu-1.4 kowokuqala futhi u--0.2 kowesibili, ngakho u-<1 uneliswa owesibili kuphela. f: u-sin θ × cos θ>0 usho u-cos θ>0, ngakho owokuqala kuphela uyanelisa. U-b, d, no-e baneliswa bobabili abantu abangaba nguwo, ngakho abakwazi ukubahlukanisa.

y-m-60-02.title: I-exponent enkulu ihlala inani elikhulu?
y-m-60-02.topic: Ukuqhathanisa ama-exponent: amacala lapho isiqondiso sokungalingani sincike esisekelweni
y-m-60-02.goal: Funda ukuthi 'wonke amacala engiwahlolile ayasebenza' akubufakazi obanele besitatimende esijwayelekile, yakha wena isibonelo esiphikisayo, bese ukhetha imibandela edingekayo ukufinyelela esiphethweni.
y-m-60-02.material: UMinji uthe, "a iyiphozithivu futhi a≠1. Khona-ke uma aᵐ < aⁿ, khona-ke m < n." (m no-n kuyizinombolo zangempela. Indlela yokufunda: aᵐ ithi 'a ngamandla e-m'.) UMinji uhlole ukuthi nge-a=2, 2¹ < 2³, futhi nge-a=3, 3² < 3⁵, futhi kuwo womabili amacala m<n.
y-m-60-02.thinking.0: Hlulela ukuthi izibonelo zimele kangakanani (yiliphi ibanga lezisekelo elihloliwe)
y-m-60-02.prereq.0: Amandla nemithetho yama-exponent (kuhlanganise nama-exponent anegethivu no-zero)
y-m-60-02.prereq.2: Leli yizinga lobunzima lalo msebenzi (H3), hhayi ukwabelwa konyaka wesikole, futhi licabanga ukuthi usuqedile iyunithi yama-exponent nama-logarithm.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.prompt: Ngokususelwe ezibonelweni ezimbili uMinji azihloliwe, yisiphi isitatimende esifaneleke kakhulu mayelana nesitatimende sikaMinji?
y-m-60-02.s.s1.hint.0: Bheka ukuthi amanani uMinji awahlolile aqoqene kuphi ebangeni elingenzeka lika-a.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha a eyodwa ebangeni elingazange lihlolwe bese ubala ngempela aᵐ no-aⁿ.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.o.a: Kusebenze kabili, ngo-2 no-3, ngakho singasho ukuthi isitatimende sibamba kuwo wonke u-a
y-m-60-02.s.s1.r.a: Ukusebenza kabili akuwubufakazi. Qala ubheke ukuthi izisekelo ezihloliwe zivela ebangeni liphi lezinombolo.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.o.b: Asikwazi ukuqiniseka size sihlole ngokwehlukana amacala lapho m no-n kuyizinombolo zangempela ezingewona izinombolo ezigcwele
y-m-60-02.s.s1.r.b: Inkinga ibanga lesisekelo a kunebanga lika-m no-n. Bheka futhi amanani ka-a ahloliwe.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.o.c: Izisekelo ezihloliwe zonke zikhulu kuno-1, ngakho singaqiniseka kuphela ngemva kokuhlola nezisekelo ezincane kuno-1
y-m-60-02.s.s1.o.d: Izibonelo ezibambayo azibhubhisi isitatimende, ngakho uma kungavezi isibonelo esiphikisayo, singasamukela njengeqiniso
y-m-60-02.s.s1.r.d: Ukungabhekanga isibonelo esiphikisayo kuhlukile ekutheni asikho isibonelo esiphikisayo. Bheka ukuthi yimaphi amanani ka-a angakahlolwa.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.explain: Izisekelo ezihloliwe 2 no-3 zombili zikhulu kuno-1. Njengoba a ingaba 0<a<1 nayo, asikwazi ukusho 'njalo' size sihlole leli cala. Ukuthi izibonelo ezihloliwe zimele ibanga liphi kunquma ukuthi ubufakazi bunamandla kangakanani.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza bese ufaka ama-(a, m, n) amabili anezisekelo a ezihlukile ukuze aᵐ < aⁿ kodwa m>n. (a iyinombolo enkulu kuno-0 futhi ayilingani no-1. Ungayibhala njengedesimali.)
y-m-60-02.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha a ibe yinombolo encane kuno-1, bese ubala amanani ambalwa ubone ukuthi aᵐ ishintsha kanjani njengoba m ikhula.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha izinombolo ezimbalwa ezigcwele zika-m no-n, bala a^m no-a^n, bese uqhathanisa osayizi bazo.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.ok.c1: a inkulu kuno-0 futhi ayiyona u-1.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.fail.c1: a kufanele ibe yiphozithivu futhi ingalingani no-1.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.fail.c2: m ayinkulu kuno-n. Khetha izinombolo ezimbili ezine-m>n.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.fail.c3: aᵐ ayincane kuno-aⁿ. Bala ngempela wonke amanani womabili bese uyaqhathanisa.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo, nge-a=0.5, m=3, n=1, sithola 0.5³=0.125 < 0.5¹=0.5 noma m>n. Nge-a=0.25, m=2, n=−1, sithola 0.0625 < 4. Isitatimende sikaMinji asibambi ku-0<a<1.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.prompt: Kusukela eqinisweni lokuthi aᵐ < aⁿ, yini enye odinga ukuyazi, ngaphezu kombandela ongenhla (a iyiphozithivu, a≠1), ukuze ukwazi ukuphetha ngokuthi m < n? Khetha konke okwanele. (Ungazi ngokwakha izibonelo eziphikisayo nokuhlola.)
y-m-60-02.s.s3.hint.0: Kukhetho ngalunye, funa i-(a, m, n) efeza umbandela waso futhi isiyisibonelo esiphikisayo.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.hint.1: Kukhetho ngalunye, hlola ukuthi ibanga elisele lika-a liqukethe izinombolo ezincane kuno-1 yini.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.r.a: Uma a iyinombolo yemvelo futhi ingeyona u-1, cabanga ukuthi a iqala kuphi. Bhala inani elincane kakhulu elingenzeka.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.o.b: Iqiniso lokuthi m no-n kokubili kuyizinombolo eziphozithivu
y-m-60-02.s.s3.r.b: a=0.5, m=3, n=1 inazo zombili m no-n eziphozithivu, kodwa aᵐ<aⁿ kuyilapho m>n.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.r.c: Nge-a=0.7, m=3, n=1, sithola 0.343<0.7 noma m>n.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.r.d: Uma a inkulu kuno-1, aˣ ishintsha kuphela ohlangothini olwandayo, ngakho isiqondiso sokungalingani siyagcinwa.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.r.e: Ngumbandela esivele siwazi, ngakho akuyona ulwazi olusha. Awehlukanisi a>1 no-0<a<1.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.explain: Uma a>1, aˣ iyakhula, ngakho aᵐ<aⁿ ⇒ m<n. Uma a iyinombolo yemvelo ngaphandle kuka-1, khona-ke a≥2, ngakho a>1, okwanele nakho. Kokuthi b, c, no-e, amanani ka-a angu-0<a<1 asala, ngakho isibonelo esiphikisayo siyenzeka. Ngendlela, uma 0<a<1 ibisaziwe, isiphetho besiyoba ngu-m>n esikhundleni salokho.

y-m-60-01.title: Isixazululo esisodwa kuphela? Umsebenzi uphutha kuphi?
y-m-60-01.topic: Izici zama-logarithm nombandela we-argument: izixazululo ze-log₂(x²)=4
y-m-60-01.goal: Funda ukuthi isinyathelo esisebenzisa isici se-logarithm singashintsha ibanga elivunyelwe lika-x, thola umugqa lapho izixazululo zinyamalala khona bese ulungisa, bese ukhetha izinyathelo ezingashintshi ibanga.
y-m-60-01.material: USuho uxazulule isibalo log₂(x²) = 4 (x iyinombolo yangempela engeyona u-0) njengoba kukhonjisiwe ngezansi. (Indlela yokufunda: log₂ A ithi 'i-logarithm ka-A nesisekelo 2', futhi x² ithi 'x ngesikwele'.)
y-m-60-01.thinking.0: Hlola ukuthi umugqa ngamunye uyabamba ngaphansi kwemibandela efanayo nomugqa osandulela yini
y-m-60-01.thinking.2: Qhathanisa ibanga elivunyelwe ngaphambi nangemva koshintsho
y-m-60-01.prereq.0: Incazelo nezici zama-logarithm (i-argument kufanele ibe yiphozithivu, futhi log M^k = k·log M isetshenziswa uma M>0)
y-m-60-01.prereq.1: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinombolo ezinenani eliphelele nesikwele esifanayo
y-m-60-01.prereq.2: Leli yizinga lobunzima lalo msebenzi (H3), hhayi ukwabelwa konyaka wesikole, futhi licabanga ukuthi usuvele wafunda izici zama-exponent nama-logarithm.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa esixazululweni sikaSuho lapho siphutha khona.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.hint.0: Qhathanisa ukuthi umugqa ngamunye uyabamba ebangeni elifanayo lika-x nomugqa osandulela yini.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.hint.1: Faka u-x oyedwa onegethivu esibalweni sokuqala bese uhlola ukuthi inani limiswe yini.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 2 yilapho kuphutha khona. log₂ x ingasetshenziswa kuphela uma x iyiphozithivu, kodwa isibalo sokuqala sisenengqondo uma x inegethivu, ngoba x² iyiphozithivu. Umugqa 2 ushiya icala x<0, futhi ngenxa yalokho isitatimende 'esisodwa kuphela' emugqeni 5 siyisiphetho esingalungile. Umugqa 5 nawo wamukelwa njengomugqa ongalungile. Noma x = −4 inika log₂ 16 = 4.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.prompt: Thola futhi ufake izinombolo zangempela ezimbili ezahlukile x ezifeza isibalo sokuqala log₂(x²) = 4.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.hint.0: Usebenzisa incazelo ye-logarithm, bhala kabusha log₂ A = 4 njengobudlelwano phakathi kuka-A no-2.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.hint.1: Faka u-x owuthole ku-log₂(x²) yokuqala bese uhlola ukuthi uthola u-4.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Uma x=0, khona-ke x²=0, ngakho i-argument ye-logarithm ayiyona iphozithivu.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Inani le-log₂(x²) alingu-4. Cabanga futhi ukuthi amandla ka-2 anika x².
y-m-60-01.s.s2.explain: Ngencazelo ye-logarithm, x² = 2⁴ = 16, ngakho x = 4 noma x = −4. Womabili amanani afeza isibalo sokuqala, ngakho kunezixazululo ezimbili.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.prompt: Ushintsho njengomugqa 2 kaSuho lungashintsha ibanga elivunyelwe lika-x. Khetha zonke izinguquko ezingezansi lapho 'ibanga lamanani ongawathatha x liyafana ngaphambi nangemva'. (x iyinombolo yangempela.)
y-m-60-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kuhlangothi lwesobunxele nolwesokudla lokukhetha ngakunye, bhala ngokwehlukana 'x kufanele ibe ngaphakathi kwebanga lini ukuze inani ngaphakathi kwe-logarithm libe yiphozithivu', bese uqhathanisa.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kokukhetha lapho amabanga abukeka ehlukile, faka u-x oyedwa onegethivu ezinhlangothini zombili.

y-m-60-07.title: Ukuhlola isixazululo esithola igama elijwayelekile kusuka efomulweni yesamu
y-m-60-07.topic: Isamu lochungechunge negama laso elijwayelekile: ukuhlola igama lokuqala lapho kutholwa u-aₙ kusuka ku-Sₙ
y-m-60-07.goal: Esixazululweni esithola igama elijwayelekile kusuka kusamu u-Sₙ, thola lapho umcabango u-n≥2 uswele khona, uhlole ngezinombolo eziqondile, futhi wakhe wena ifomula yesamu lapho igama lokuqala lingadingi ukulungiswa ngokuhlukile.
y-m-60-07.material: Ochungechungeni u-{aₙ}, isamu legama lokuqala kuya egameni lesi-n ngu-Sₙ = n² + 2n + 3 (u-n uyinombolo yemvelo), futhi uEunwoo wathola igama elijwayelekile njengoba kungezansi. (Indlela yokufunda: u-aₙ ngu-'igama lesi-n', u-Sₙ ngu-'isamu kusukela egameni lokuqala kuya egameni lesi-n', futhi u-Sₙ₋₁ ngu-'isamu kuze kufike egameni lesi-(n−1)'.)
y-m-60-07.prereq.0: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwesamu u-Sₙ negama elijwayelekile u-aₙ lochungechunge (u-Sₙ yisamu legama lokuqala kuya egameni lesi-n)
y-m-60-07.prereq.1: Ukwelula nokwenza izisho ze-quadratic zibe lula
y-m-60-07.prereq.2: Lesi sinqumo sizinga lobunzima salo msebenzi (H3), hhayi ukwabiwa konyaka wesikole, futhi sicabanga ukuthi uqedile inyunithi yochungechunge.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa esixazululweni sikaEunwoo lapho siphosa khona.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.hint.0: Qhathanisa isiphetho u-a₁ = 3 ngqo nencazelo luka-S₁ (isamu legama lokuqala kuya egameni lokuqala).
y-m-60-07.s.s1.hint.1: Bheka ukuthi u-Sₙ₋₁ uba yini uma ufaka u-n=1 efomulweni yomugqa 1.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.line.3: Ngakho kunoma iyiphi inombolo yemvelo u-n, u-aₙ = 2n + 1.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 1 usebenza kuphela uma u-n≥2. U-S₀ akachazwanga, ngakho akakwazi ukusetshenziswa ku-n=1. Ngakho u-'noma iyiphi inombolo yemvelo u-n' emgqeni 4 no-a₁ = 3 emgqeni 5 kuphosile. Igama lokuqala ngu-a₁ = S₁ = 1 + 2 + 3 = 6. Ukubala emigqeni 2 no-3 (u-2n+1 ku-n≥2) kulungile. Ukukhetha noma yimuphi umugqa 1, umugqa 4, noma umugqa 5 kuyamukelwa.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.prompt: U-Sₙ = pn² + qn + r (u-p, q, r bayizinombolo eziphelele, p≥1), u-S₃ = 21, futhi igama lokuqala u-a₁ = S₁ ungu-1 okungenani. Kulokhu, thola amanani amabili ahlukile luka-p lapho inani elitholwe ngokufaka u-n=1 efomulweni evela ku-aₙ = Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ (ku-n≥2) lilingana no-S₁ (okungukuthi, amacala lapho igama lokuqala lingadingi ukulungiswa ngokuhlukile), futhi uwafake.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.hint.0: Bala u-Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ ngqo ku-pn² + qn + r futhi uwenze abe isisho ku-n.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.hint.1: Thola isimo esenza inani laleso sisho ku-n=1 lilingane no-S₁ = p + q + r.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.ok.c1: U-p, q, r bayizinombolo eziphelele futhi u-p≥1.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.fail.c1: U-p, q, r kumele babe yizinombolo eziphelele, futhi u-p kumele abe ngu-1 okungenani.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.fail.c3: U-S₁ = p + q + r ungaphansi kuka-1.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.ok.c4: Inani lefomula ye-n≥2 ku-n=1 lilingana no-S₁.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.fail.c4: Ukufaka u-n=1 efomulweni u-2pn + (q−p) etholwe ku-n≥2 kunika u-p+q. Hlola ukuthi u-r kumele abe yini ukuze lokhu kulingane no-S₁ = p+q+r.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.explain: Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ = 2pn + (q − p), futhi ukufaka u-n=1 kunika u-p + q. Ukuze lokhu kulingane no-S₁ = p + q + r, u-r = 0 uyadingeka. Khona-ke u-S₃ = 9p + 3q = 21, okungukuthi, u-3p + q = 7, futhi amapheya ezinombolo eziphelele anelisa u-S₁ ≥ 1 ngu-(p, q) = (1, 4), (2, 1), (3, −2). Isibonelo, uma u-Sₙ = 3n² − 2n, khona-ke u-aₙ = 6n − 5 nawo uyasebenza ku-n=1 (a₁ = 1).
y-m-60-07.s.s3.prompt: Emshweni owodwa noma emibili, usebenzisa okungenani inani elilodwa eliqondile (inombolo), bhala ukuthi kungani kuphosile ukusebenzisa u-aₙ = 2n + 1 kuwo wonke u-n ku-Sₙ = n² + 2n + 3 kaEunwoo.
y-m-60-07.s.s3.hint.0: Bheka ukuthi u-Sₙ₋₁ uyini uma u-n=1 ku-aₙ = Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ kaEunwoo.
y-m-60-07.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala eceleni komunye inani luka-S₁ elibaliwe ngqo nenani luka-2n+1 ku-n=1.
y-m-60-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Usebenzise iqiniso lokuthi u-a₁ ulingana no-S₁ ukuthola u-6?
y-m-60-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ukhombise ukungavumelani ngokuqhathanisa nenani luka-2n+1 ku-n=1?
y-m-60-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Usho nokuthi le fomula ingasetshenziswa kuphela ku-n≥2?
y-m-60-07.s.s3.model.0: U-a₁ ngu-S₁, ngakho ungu-1 + 2 + 3 = 6, kodwa ukufaka u-n=1 ku-2n + 1 kunika u-3, ngakho ahlukile. Ngakho le fomula ingasetshenziswa kuphela ku-n≥2, futhi igama lokuqala kumele lithole ngokuhlukile.
y-m-60-07.s.s3.model.1: Igama lokuqala ngu-S₁ = 6. Kodwa ukufaka u-n=1 ku-aₙ = 2n+1 kunika u-3, ngakho kuphosile. Ukusebenzisa u-Sₙ₋₁, u-n kumele abe ngu-2 okungenani, ngakho u-n=1 kumele ahlolwe ngokuhlukile.
